title: About Me
text: Hello there! I am Naman Goyal, a human from planet Earth. I am currently a first-year undergraduate pursuing a B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Kanpur. I have a deep interest in mathematics and music. In particular, I like listening to rock music, playing the guitar and keyboard, and singing. Apart from this, I am also interested in bird-watching and photography. In my free time, I sometimes play table tennis.
